name: Wolverine (X-23)

abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Vicious: Hasar veren debuff'ların gücünü belirtilen miktarda artırır.
abilityDetails.Marked: Regeneration, Immortality, Indestructible ve Death Immunity etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %100 azaltır.

signatureAbility:
More Than Just an Animal
While a Skill Opponent is suffering from 8 or more personal Bleed or Rupture effects, performing Special Attacks or activating Eviscerating Stun inflicts a Marked Passive for 5 seconds.
When Laura is inflicted with a Bleed effect, she has a [35 - 80]% chance to gain a personal Regeneration Passive.
Increase personal Vicious potency by [13 - 50]%.

abilitySections.title: Born to Kill - Always Active
content: Laura's healing factor prevents her Regeneration Rate from being decreased and lowers the duration of incoming Bleed effects by 90% and Poison effects by 60%. However, her Critical Penetration is reduced by 30% flat.

Against Skill Champions, Laura's Parry Mastery inflicts a Stun Passive instead, lasting for 1.5 seconds. For each rank invested in the Petrify Mastery, this Stun Passive reduces the Opponent's Regeneration and Combat Power Rates by 10%.

Performing an Intercept or Punishing the Opponent's Special Attacks grants Laura a Pursuit Passive for 4 seconds, or 8 seconds against Skill Champions. This is paused during Laura's Special Attacks. Hits that grant Pursuit cannot be Evaded.
The Wolverine Relic grants +[305.56] Critical Rating while Laura has a Regeneration effect active.

abilitySections.title: Cellular Regeneration
content: When Laura is struck, she has a 15% chance to gain a Regeneration Passive healing 15% of missing Health over 16 seconds. Max stacks: 2. As a Defender, these heal 3% of missing Health instead.
After knocking down her Opponent, Laura stands still for 0.8 second, if she does not perform an action before this ends, she will consume 20 Frenzy to gain a personal Regeneration Passive.

abilitySections.title: Frenzy
content: Laura builds up Frenzy throughout the fight by performing the following actions:
Striking the Opponent grants Laura 2 Frenzy. Striking the Opponent with a Pursuit effect active grants 4 Frenzy instead.
Frenzy rapidly falls off after not gaining Frenzy for 2.6 seconds. It cannot fall off during Special Attacks, while hitting the Opponent's Block, or while Laura's Striker is active.
Gain up to +[10,345.24] Critical Rating based on Frenzy, maxing at 100 Frenzy.

abilitySections.title: Lacerating Critical Hits
content: Laura's Critical Hits lacerate her Opponents, inflicting a [3,332.16] Bleed Passive for 12 seconds. All personal Damaging effects scale with Base Attack only but are affected by Class relationships.
Against non-Tech Bleed Immune Champions, Laura changes her fighting style to instead inflict Ruptures, copying personal Bleed behavior but with 30% reduced potency.

abilitySections.title: Tapping into Instincts
content: As an Attacker, Laura's fourth Light Attack while over 100 Frenzy inflicts an Eviscerating Stun Passive for 3 seconds. For every 10 Frenzy above 100, this duration is increased by 0.2 seconds. All Frenzy is consumed at the end of this Stun.

During Eviscerating Stun, Laura can rapidly perform Light Attacks. If the Opponent is suffering from a Bleed or Rupture effect, each Light Attack inflicts a matching Instant effect dealing a burst of [187.43] damage for each active matching effect.

Additionally during Eviscerating Stun, the Opponent is locked in place, Laura cannot activate Strikers or Specials, and her Combat Power Rate is reduced by 75%. Performing any action that is not a Light Attack ends Eviscerating Stun early.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Arterial Strike
content: Personal Bleed, Rupture, and Cruelty effects are paused during this Special Attack and for 5 seconds after.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Triplicate Slash
content: On activation, gain a non-stacking 20% Vicious Passive for 10 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks. While active, Critical Hits inflict an additional Bleed Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Eviscerating Offense
content: Consume all Frenzy to grant Laura a +[144.74] Cruelty Passive for every 20 Frenzy consumed for 8 seconds. Max stacks: 12. These expire one at a time.
